meta.title: Humanitarian appeals and plans covering Lebanon
meta.publisher: UN OCHA FTS (plans, flows); cross-check OCHA Centre for Humanitarian Data HAPI funding endpoint
meta.license_note: FTS terms: reuse with attribution. HAPI funding (HDX) CC BY-IGO.
meta.pct_funded: Computed here as funding_planwide_usd / requirements_usd (FTS plan-level incoming funding over revised requirements), only for Lebanon-only plans. HAPI figures differ slightly (HAPI snapshot; for example FLBN20 82.8% versus 83.9% here).
meta.lcrp: The Lebanon Crisis Response Plan is the Lebanon part of the 3RP and has no separate FTS plan; see the RSYR rows (2015 onward) and reach-selfreported.jsonl.
meta.excluded: Pre-2013 regional plans 291 and 329 (Iraqi refugees) are kept because they list Lebanon funding. Lebanon was not a country in the Syria Regional Response Plan before 2012.
meta.double_counting: Plan funding overlaps with fts-years.json totals (same flows grouped by plan); never add them. Unplanned funding sits outside any plan.

appeals.name: Iraq and the region 2009
appeals.requirements_scope: whole plan, all countries (Lebanon share not given by the API)
appeals.notes: Regional plan: requirements and plan-wide funding cover all countries. funding_to_lebanon_usd is the FTS funding tagged to Lebanon. The Lebanon chapter of the 3RP is the Lebanon Crisis Response Plan (LCRP); The API plan record carries only the whole-plan requirement. requirements_lebanon_usd_hapi is the requirement that HAPI (HDX) attributes to Lebanon for the plan and pct_funded_lebanon_hapi_basis divides Lebanon-tagged funding by it; checked: it equals the sum of requested funds of the Lebanon-located projects in the HDX HRP projects file for each plan 2021-2025, and matches the appeal size printed in the LRP end-of-year inter-sector dashboards (2021 $2.75bn, 2022 $3.2bn, 2023 $3.6bn, 2024 $2.72bn; 2025 dashboard prints $3.006bn against 2.992bn here).
